construction: Equal-weighted, monthly-rebalanced, buy-and-hold between rebalances; dated membership changes take effect same-day.
history_note: Curated 2026-06 with knowledge of the period — the full ~3y series is a HINDSIGHT backtest of the as-of-creation membership, not an out-of-sample track. A monitoring/structure frame, not a buy list.
note: Equal-weight thematic baskets over the FREE S&P-1500 price cache. Membership is explicit, dated and auditable. Curated 2026-06 with knowledge of the period, so the full ~3y series is HINDSIGHT-curated and descriptive — not an out-of-sample backtest. A few on-thesis names outside that cache (recent IPOs, crypto & nuclear) are carried in a separate baskets-only cache (data/baskets/extras.parquet) and flagged partial where their history is short.

baskets.name: Travel & Experiences
baskets.thesis: Travel and experiences — airlines, cruises, lodging and gaming. The 'experiences over goods' consumer trade; high operating leverage cuts both ways and it's first to roll over on a consumer slowdown.

members.name: Live Nation Entertainment
members.rationale: Live Nation — concerts & ticketing; the purest 'experiences over goods' name

changelog.note: Seeded Travel & Experiences — 13 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Added LYV (Live Nation) — the live-entertainment expression the thesis was missing.

baskets.name: Regional Banks
baskets.thesis: Mid- and large-regional lenders — the cleanest expression of the yield curve, CRE credit and deposit competition. Re-rate on steepening and rate cuts; the tail risk is CRE losses and a deposit-flight repeat.

changelog.note: Seeded Regional Banks — 8 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Theme names outside the free S&P-1500 cache, excluded: ZION, CMA (not in free cache).

baskets.name: Retail
baskets.thesis: Big-box, off-price and discount retail — a consumer-health and trade-down gauge. Off-price and discounters win in a stretched consumer; discretionary big-box is the spend-confidence tell.

members.name: Dollar General
members.rationale: Rural discount; low-end consumer stress tell

changelog.note: Seeded Retail — 10 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.

baskets.name: Managed Care & Insurers
baskets.thesis: Health insurers and managed-care orgs — defensive cash flows whipsawed by the medical-loss-ratio cycle and Medicare Advantage rate notices. A policy-and-utilization trade more than a growth one.

changelog.note: Seeded Managed Care & Insurers — 6 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.

baskets.name: Housing Chain
baskets.thesis: The housing chain — builders and building-products — geared to mortgage rates and the structural under-supply of US homes. Rate-cut beneficiaries with order-cancellation risk if rates stay high.

members.name: Sherwin-Williams
members.rationale: Coatings pricing power across the cycle

changelog.note: Seeded Housing Chain — 9 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Theme names outside the free S&P-1500 cache, excluded: WHR (not in free cache).

baskets.name: Defensives
baskets.thesis: Staples and defensive cash-flows — the low-beta ballast that leads in risk-off and lags in risk-on. A relative-performance regime tell more than an absolute-return engine; GLP-1 and private-label are the structural cross-currents.

members.name: Kenvue
members.rationale: Kenvue — consumer-health staple (Tylenol/Listerine); a pure defensive

changelog.note: Seeded Defensives — 10 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Added KVUE (Kenvue) — a pure consumer-health staple (the basket had no clean one).

baskets.name: Reshoring & Industrial Capex
baskets.thesis: Beneficiaries of onshoring and the US industrial-capex super-cycle: automation, power distribution, machinery and the equipment-rental layer. Levered to factory construction and IRA/CHIPS spending; sensitive to rates and the capex cycle turning.

changelog.note: Seeded Reshoring & Industrial Capex — 9 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Theme names outside the free S&P-1500 cache, excluded: GGG (not in free cache).

baskets.name: Defense & Aerospace
baskets.thesis: Primes and defense-tech levered to a rising global budget cycle: missiles, aircraft, space and the new autonomy entrants. Long-cycle backlog visibility; the cross-current is procurement reform and budget-ceiling risk.

members.name: Kratos Defense & Security
members.rationale: Kratos — drones, hypersonics & space; defense-tech beta

members.name: RKLB
members.rationale: Rocket Lab — small-launch + space systems; the new-space leader

changelog.note: Seeded Defense & Aerospace — 10 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.
Added the defense-tech / new-space leg (AVAV, KTOS in-cache; RKLB, ASTS off-index via the extras cache).

baskets.name: US Energy Complex
baskets.thesis: The US energy complex end-to-end: integrateds, E&P, oilfield services, refiners and midstream. A crude-price + capital-discipline trade; midstream adds a data-center-power/natgas demand kicker.

changelog.note: Seeded US Energy Complex — 11 equal-weight members from the S&P 1500 cache.

baskets.name: Crypto & Digital Assets
baskets.thesis: Listed crypto-equity beta — the US exchange (COIN), retail brokerage (HOOD), the bitcoin-treasury proxy (MSTR), the USDC stablecoin issuer (CRCL), a crypto merchant bank (GLXY) and the bitcoin miners (MARA/RIOT/CLSK). The cleanest public sensor for the crypto regulatory & liquidity cycle — and by far the highest-beta basket here: it amplifies bitcoin both ways. Several members are 2025 IPOs, so their early history is partial. A regime sensor, not a buy list.
